Definition: of uncertain origin; Theudas, an Israelite:--Theudas.
BiblicalUsage: Theudas is a rebel leader Gamaliel names when he warns the council against fighting God. In Acts 5:36, before these days rose up Theudas.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Theudas is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
